summary.caption: A 2.39:1 anamorphic widescreen key frame from an epic fantasy film: a boundless floating-island world at first light, photographed on a 24mm wide-angle lens from a low cliff-top vantage, deep focus f/16 so foreground rock, midground citadel and distant peaks all stay crisp. Composition follows the golden ratio: the luminous world-tree and its white marble citadel occupy the right third, while the left half opens into a sea of clouds and generous negative space that carries the eye. The sun sits behind and to the left of the citadel, backlighting the entire scene: volumetric god rays fan through gaps in the cloud, rim light traces every spire and leaf, and the near cliff stays a dark high-contrast silhouette. Three depth planes separated by atmospheric haze rather than blur: dark warm-toned foreground, cool teal midground, pale violet-blue distant mountain ranges fading into a horizon-high cloud sea. Teal-and-gold cinematic grading, restrained saturation, fine film grain, subtle vignette, immense scale conveyed by tiny human figures and tiny dragons. STRUCTURE RULE: only ONE architectural complex exists in the whole image, the hero citadel on the right. Every distant island is pure natural rock, water and vegetation, reduced by heavy aerial haze to broad simple low-contrast silhouettes with absolutely no buildings, no towers, no columns and no fine detail. Keep the cloud sea clean and empty, with no extra small built-up islands. No text, no watermark, no logos.

items.label: object
items.caption: Near foreground: a dark, richly textured cliff ledge in near-silhouette, its top edge rim-lit by the low sun. Two minuscule cloaked travelers stand at the very edge beside a worn stone waymark, dwarfed by the landscape; they are the scale anchor and the darkest value in the frame. Warm brown rock, crisp detail, strong diagonal leading line toward the right. Natural rock only, no architecture here.

items.label: object
items.caption: The visual hero at the right third: a gigantic ancient world-tree with luminous turquoise foliage, its massive roots wrapping ONE readable white-marble citadel built from a few large solid masses: one dominant broad central tower with a pyramidal roof, three or four clearly separated square side towers with wide facades, rows of large arched windows and heavy horizontal terrace bands. Architecture reads as big blocky volumes and calm horizontal lines, NOT as needle-like pinnacles or a forest of thin vertical rods. Strongly backlit with a bright rim light, tall but simple silhouette rising above the cloud sea, a few wide waterfalls falling from the terraces. No tiny repeated spikes anywhere.

items.label: object
items.caption: Mid-to-far left: a low, broad flat-topped natural rock island with a single wide waterfall spilling from one edge and a few windswept trees. Pure geology and water, NO buildings, NO towers, NO spires, NO columns, NO ruins. Simplified flat silhouette, very low contrast, cool blue aerial perspective, deliberately kept small and quiet to preserve negative space.

items.label: object
items.caption: Far right edge: a distant horizontal mass of natural rock and layered snow peaks, one soft wide waterfall, almost lost in violet-blue haze. Pure natural landscape with NO architecture of any kind, no thin vertical structures, simplified into a broad hazy shape, minimal detail.

items.label: object
items.caption: Three tiny long-winged dragons circling high above the canopy, backlit silhouettes with a warm edge glow, deliberately very small to emphasize the monumental scale of the tree.

items.label: object
items.caption: The low sun just above the cloud horizon, partially veiled, casting long volumetric god rays diagonally across the cloud sea toward the citadel; the brightest point of the image, soft golden bloom, no lens flare artifacts.
